stories.title: Forecast: One more chilly morning, then trending warmer
stories.summary: Here are the latest updates from the KVUE Weather Impact Team.

stories.title: Kyle City Council considers starting process to ban data centers
stories.summary: Kyle city leaders are considering a ban on data centers amid residents' concerns over resource strain, with discussions led by Councilmember Claudia Zapata.

stories.title: Packed house in Georgetown as residents push back against proposed data center
stories.summary: Residents packed city council chambers, the lobby and sidewalk on Tuesday night, raising concerns about a proposed 68-megawatt data center near their homes.

stories.title: UT plans $3M parking lot at former Erwin Center site
stories.summary: The Erwin Center was home to the Longhorns' men's and women's basketball teams before the Moody Center opened in 2022.

stories.title: USDA awards $5M to Safe Summers Foundation after Camp Mystic flood tragedy
stories.summary: The foundation gives grants to camps that need money or technical help to meet new safety standards.

stories.title: Police searching for suspect accused of assaulting Downtown Austin security guard
stories.summary: The incident happened at 500 N. Lamar Blvd., near West Fifth Street, on Nov. 5.

stories.title: Austin City Council could approve deal this week to save Lions Municipal Golf Course
stories.summary: The proposed agreement with the University of Texas would transfer ownership of the historic golf course to the city, protecting it from future development.

stories.title: Texas maternal death rate drops to pre-pandemic levels as mental health becomes the leading cause
stories.summary: The highly anticipated maternal mortality report published Friday after the state delayed its release until after the midterm elections.

stories.title: Texas lawmaker files bill to strengthen Lone Star Card security following millions in stolen SNAP benefits
stories.summary: A KVUE investigation revealed widespread SNAP benefit theft across Texas, exposing security gaps that have left thousands of families vulnerable.

stories.title: Ken Paxton’s office drops lawsuit seeking to ban Muslim civil rights group in Texas
stories.summary: The attorney general’s office has abandoned several other lawsuits since the Democratic sweep in the midterm elections.

stories.title: Here’s who’s playing Austin’s Sips & Sounds Music Festival in 2027
stories.summary: The two-day festival will return to Auditorium Shores on March 5-6, 2027.

stories.title: American Airlines settles lawsuit over claims of flight attendant secretly recording Austin girl in airplane bathroom
stories.summary: The lawsuit stemmed from a 2023 incident, where it was alleged that the airline was liable for the former flight attendant's actions.
